category_description: Saving, investing and protecting your money in the United States.
subcategory_description: How deposits are protected if a bank fails.
label: Standard deposit insurance amount
context: Per depositor, per FDIC-insured bank, for each account ownership category. All of your deposits in the same ownership category at the same bank are added together.

label: Trust account coverage per eligible beneficiary
context: Per trust owner, for each unique eligible beneficiary. The count covers revocable and irrevocable trust accounts at the same bank. A beneficiary named on several of an owner's trust accounts counts once.

label: Most a trust owner can be insured for at one bank
context: Applies to a trust owner with five or more eligible beneficiaries, and is the same however many more are named. Where a trust has more than one owner, each owner's coverage is worked out separately.

subject_intro: What FDIC deposit insurance covers, what it does not, how ownership categories add up, and how joint and trust accounts are insured.
